name: Golang compiled binary symbol recovery and routine analysis
topic: Golang compiled binary symbol recovery and routine analysis
description: Golang compiled binary symbol recovery and routine analysis -- a medium-tier reverse engineering challenge. Review the bundled artifacts, locate the encoded clue, decode it, and recover the flag. Flag format: pwn{...}
objectives: Inspect the challenge bundle for "Golang compiled binary symbol recovery and routine analysis"
Locate the encoded artifact (look in every shipped file)
Unwrap the encoding applied to the artifact
Recover the plaintext flag and submit it in pwn{...} format

hints.text: Start by inspecting every file in the bundle (hex dump, headers, magic bytes).
The artifact is wrapped in a non-text container -- use the right parser.
The artifact is base64. After decoding you have a 4-byte XOR cipher -- recover the key by crib-dragging against the known flag prefix.
